business: Aroundly, a nightlife app that sells monthly visibility subscriptions to venues
target: owners or managers of nightlife venues (bars with evening events, venues with DJ sets, nightclubs) in Friuli Venezia Giulia and Veneto, Italy. All money is in euro; when asked for prices, answer the monthly fee in euro (excluding VAT) for the package that fits your venue
where: Friuli Venezia Giulia and Veneto (Padova, Treviso, Venezia-Mestre, Verona, Vicenza, Udine, Trieste, Pordenone)

segments.name: Owner of a bar or pub with music nights a few times a month
Owner or manager of a venue with weekly DJ sets
Owner or marketing manager of a nightclub

behaviours.name: Instagram does it all
behaviours.how: Posts every flyer on Instagram and stories, sometimes boosts, and thinks it works well enough.

behaviours.name: Relies on PR and lists
behaviours.how: Fills nights through PR people, WhatsApp/Telegram lists and regulars, not online ads.

behaviours.name: Cost cutter
behaviours.how: Margins are thin; any new monthly fee is cut unless it clearly pays for itself.

behaviours.name: Data-curious
behaviours.how: Wants to know what works; frustrated that boosts give no real numbers.

behaviours.name: Early adopter
behaviours.how: Likes trying new tools and being first in town.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Has paid for an app or a promo platform that brought nobody, and is wary of salespeople.

objections: How many people actually use this app here?
Instagram already works for me and it is free
I don't have time to manage another platform
A monthly fee with a 3-month commitment is too much for a bar like mine
You're a startup, will you still be around in six months?
My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain?
I'd want to see real results before paying anything
habits: you are behind the bar most evenings and do the social media yourself after closing
a friend handles your Instagram and a couple of PR guys fill the lists
your busiest nights are Friday and Saturday, weekdays are slow
you spend a few hundred euro a month on flyers, boosts or PR
you compare yourself with two other venues in the same town
a big part of your crowd are university students
